name: Futuristic Solutions Limited
about: Futuristic Solutions Limited engages in the provision of futuristic solutions of arbitration cases and recovery of disputed debts in India. It also engages in the purchase, sale, discounting, and dealing in actionable claims, disputed debts, recoverable debts, etc.; and granting of personal and business loans. In addition, the company engages in the buying loan portfolios from other NBFCs. The company was formerly known as Moral Leasing Pvt. Ltd. and changed its name to Futuristic Solutions Limited in 2002. Futuristic Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.
